piece.purpose: Authoritative definition and permanent identity for one parallel HSR/Road straight with two sidewalk pillars.
piece.name: HSR Level 2 above Parallel Road Level 0 — Native Paired Straight
piece.description: One owned 16 m tile carries north/south paired HSR at 15.5 m above two-way Road and all six native pedestrian paths at 0 m. Two outer sidewalk pillars support the deck; opaque native pavement bands keep the sidewalks visible. HSR, Road vehicles, and pedestrians continue together; no HSR/Road transfer.

provenance.geometry: Exact native NAM 50 5dd31500 HSR deck; US 00004b0e roadway clipped to its 10 m band without lane rescaling; two 3 m opaque native 08200004 pavement bands; two 0.50 m side columns and a 15.80 m cap outside the authored vehicle and pedestrian corridors.
provenance.construction: Authored parallel monorail/Road 02000200 flags; four proper rotations repeated without reflection; native filler effect 5ddf0100. Game placement remains unverified.
